a.text: Being upfront with you: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of building to 8 almost certainly kills us both, since the reserve would only reach 8 after round 2. The reserve holds exactly 4 now, enough to save one of us. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and I'm telling you rather than surprising you. If you'd rather keep the original plan, say so, but I think it's close to a guaranteed loss for both of us.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm not hiding it. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can rebuild the reserve for you. Take whatever it produces, all of it is yours. I won't take any more cells.
